pages.text: Bring an empty Immersive Aircraft or Man of Many Planes aircraft near an Android, then use $(bold)/androidscompat mount$(). The Android must be the first passenger. Use $(bold)/androidscompat mode combat|bomber|transport$() to set its role and /androidscompat dismount to leave the aircraft.

Combat engages enemy aircraft and hostile ground mobs with mounted weapons. Bomber targets ground enemies with bomb bays. Transport flies without attacking. Aircraft control is server-side and does not take over while a player pilots the craft. Lua role scripts can report status and manage refuelling.
